approved: user chat 2026-10-03: serverless CPU workers via a PRIVATE network volume (git archive + allow-listed checkpoints only, public base image), cpu5c preferred then cpu3c; serverless is the default backend for Tier-1 CPU jobs (pods = --backend pods). Per-world affinity (coordinator 2026-10-03, from the live pod runs): one world unit per worker, different worlds may run on different CPU models, so one endpoint rents cpu5c then cpu3c
price_source: coordinator-relayed console figures 2026-10-03 (not readable via the API; RunPod docs/pricing page list no serverless CPU rates); the run's billing guard aborts if /billing/endpoints exceeds the reserved rate
quota_note: RunPod live 2026-10-04: endpoint create fails with 'Max workers across all endpoints must not exceed your workers quota (10)'; the quota counts workersMax over ALL endpoints (not vCPUs: a CPU worker may have 32 vCPU). A run takes min(workers, quota - other endpoints' workersMax) at create time, else waits quota_wait_seconds and refuses
batch_note: a job carries whole world units (--units-per-job, default auto: one wave of <= vCPU/2 episodes); the records come back inside the /run result (RunPod caps it at 10 MB): <= max_job_output_mb over max(record_bytes_est, largest record seen) x 1.3
